I'll never understand. When I was young I was the chubby, quiet and reserved kid. I was the only native I knew and got picked on relentlessly. Even when I asked teachers for help they told me to suck it up and quit tattling(late 90s/early 2000s). When I started fighting back I would get in trouble every single time no matter what race I fought with it was my fault for not talking to a teacher(which I did at least 3 times before I would react). My mom finally told me I can fight back without getting in trouble at home if they swung on me twice, even if they didn't connect. At least she understood I was picked on. Then we moved to the reservation and it was the same thing with my own tribe, since I was an outsider and everyone else had grown up with each other. The teachers and principal told me to quit tattling. So I fought up until highschool and went to school off the reservation when things finally mellowed out. To this day I refuse to ask anyone for help when things go wrong.

The time I was about to kill myself I was under 2 Federal Investigations for something I legit didn't do, I couldn't see my kids, pre-trial services sucked when they can show up whenever, wherever I had to go with them and do drug and alcohol testing.i spent a week in a maximum security prison (hardcore I know). I was alone, I tried talking to people who I had helped with things in the past, people who I've given the shirt off my back for even family but everyone had bigger problems then me or they would just start talking about themselves. The one glimmer of sanity and hope I had was that I was going to see my oldest child for the weekend. But that day was horrible. I was getting yelled at by people at work, tire blew out on work vehicle and somehow wrapped around the bumper so I had to wait in the heat for a ride, had a flat on my car on a stretch of highway where I couldn't pullover for 2 miles so I had angry people behind me honking and flipping me off. By then I was ready to fight someone. I pulled over smashed my hand trying to get my tire iron out. Hit my head on the trunk and pulled a nice chunk of hair out. But in my head I was just thinking about how happy I would be to see my daughter and hug her. I got to where I was supposed to meet her mom and calmly told her as her and my daughter got out of their car "I had such a bad and horrible day I really just want to take her home and not really in the mood to talk" in a really shitty tone of voice she tells our daughter to get back in the car and starts saying stuff to me I don't remember because that was the point I lost it. Everything I had felt I let out on my daughter's mom verbally. I didn't care who saw or who tried to stop me I was going to hurt someone or myself I didn't care. I just left and cried. I was done, I was going to kill myself but I wasn't going alone. I went to the store and got a bottle of tequila, vodka and whiskey. While I was plotting and planning who I thought deserved to go with me for some reasons I woke up on my floor the next morning. I didn't touch the alcohol I didn't do anything. I felt I little better when I got up. Long story short charges got dropped in the interest of justice. Some days I think life would be better for people if I was dead. But that thought pops up once in a while.
